parallelization.rationale: Candidate pixel mechanisms overlap the same rasterizer, atlas, shader, and quality matrix and must be evaluated atomically one at a time.

groups.title: Select and harden the smallest passing renderer strategy

tasks.title: Run the candidate ladder and retain the first complete quality win
tasks.action: MUST start an AgentX improvement loop from the frozen Sprint 1 baseline, evaluate one primary mechanism per experiment in the fixed order of scale/sampling/gamma correction, Swash hint/raster correction, glyph-local higher-resolution coverage/downsample, then composition-safe LCD, and retain only the first smallest implementation that passes every matched DOM quality, geometry, warm p95, cache, atlas, and native-DPR gate.
proofObligations: Each experiment MUST name one primary mechanism, checkpoint all participating repositories, and commit or revert before the next candidate.
The first smallest passing strategy wins; a larger candidate cannot remain merely because it looks better subjectively.
No passing candidate means the task remains blocked rather than lowering the frozen quality gates.

reuse: Existing Swash rasterizer, RenderGlyphParams/GlyphCacheKey, glyph atlas, WGPU monochrome/subpixel pipelines, and AgentX improvement-loop state machine.
prohibitedAdditions: A second font renderer or atlas.
An application-facing setting or RayX service.
allowedAdditions: The smallest pixel-changing parameters required in the existing glyph cache identity.
A glyph-local raster/downsample scale only if earlier candidates fail.
Composition-safe LCD policy only if every earlier candidate fails and fringe gates pass.
